hazards.name: Uncontrolled Driveway Access
hazards.description: Wide, undefined vehicle access points to parking lots create conflict zones for anyone walking along the road edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the commercial signage

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian walkways
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the road shoulder near high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: High-speed arterial design
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, which significantly increases the risk of fatality in the event of a pedestrian collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Extreme crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane road and median creates a very long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians with no marked facilities.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or designated walking paths, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large service van parked in the roadway significantly blocks sightlines between drivers and any potential pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked asphalt area requires a long crossing distance without any refuge or markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Safe Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are visible for pedestrians to cross the wide, divided roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the road.

hazards.name: Absence of Walkway
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk or path, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the shoulder of a high-speed road.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are visible for pedestrians to safely cross the multi-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Undefined Driveways
hazards.description: Large expanses of asphalt for vehicle access create long conflict zones where pedestrian paths are not defined.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image leading into the commercial properties

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or paved paths, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing anyone on foot to walk in the grass or on the high-speed roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the road edge

hazards.name: High-Speed Multi-Lane Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane design encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a significant barrier for pedestrian movement.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: No physical barrier or buffer exists between the roadway and the adjacent land, exposing pedestrians to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or paved paths, forcing any pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the high-speed roadway shoulder.

hazards.name: Shoulder Obstruction
hazards.description: A large red commercial van is parked on the shoulder, forcing any pedestrian using that space into the active travel lane.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals to facilitate safe crossing of the arterial.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for bike lanes or wider pedestrian buffers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge and Crossing
interventions.description: If crossings are required, install signalized intersections with pedestrian refuge islands to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Refuges
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and median refuge islands to facilitate safer crossings of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at intersections or appropriate mid-block locations to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically directed at the new walkway to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing of the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures to reduce vehicle speeds, such as lane narrowing or adding street trees to create a vertical buffer.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Enhancements
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, pedestrian-actuated signals (such as HAWK signals), and curb ramps at regular intervals.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install a raised curb to physically separate the roadway from the pedestrian realm and manage drainage.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the wide parking lot entrance to reduce pedestrian exposure and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to improve comfort and provide a vertical cue for drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to the NACTO-recommended 10-11 feet to naturally reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals at regular intervals to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks along the roadway to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge and Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and utilize the existing median to create protected refuge islands for safer crossing.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a signalized midblock crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe opportunity to cross the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing/Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to lower vehicle speeds and shorten pedestrian crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing and Signalization
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian-activated signal or HAWK beacon.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width and number of travel lanes to lower vehicle speeds and create space for protected pedestrian and bicycle facilities.

interventions.title: Protected Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island in the median and high-visibility signage or signals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the new sidewalk and the roadway to increase safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the median to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage lower vehicle speeds and improve safety for all road users.
